name: Pearlbot
author: Techpearl

sections.description:
Pearlbot brings intelligent customer service automation to your WordPress site. Add a smart chatbot that can handle customer inquiries, process orders, and provide product information through WooCommerce integration.

Features

  • Easy setup and configuration
  • WooCommerce integration for product queries and cart management
  • Customizable chat widget appearance
  • Secure data handling with proper WordPress security practices

Please note: The Pearlbot chatbot script is hosted externally on our servers to provide dynamic AI-driven features. An internet connection is required for the chatbot to function properly. You can configure your Pearlbot chatbot by visiting the plugin’s settings page.
sections.installation:
How to Install the Pearlbot WordPress Chat Plugin:

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard.
  2. Navigate to the Plugins section from the left sidebar.
  3. Click Add New and search for “Pearlbot” in the search bar.
  4. Install and activate the Pearlbot plugin.
  5. Once activated, the live chat icon will appear in the left sidebar of your WordPress admin panel.
sections.faq:
Why is the Pearlbot script hosted externally?

The Pearlbot chatbot utilizes dynamic AI features that are hosted on our secure servers. This is essential for real-time interactions and ensures your users receive the best experience. The external dependency helps reduce plugin size and update complexities.

Do I need an API key or account?

Yes, you will need to provide a Pearlbot ID and API key to enable the chatbot functionality. You can obtain this by signing up at Pearlbot.
